package com.acme.loyalty.model;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.Arrays;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.EnumSource;

class TierTest {

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "code \"{0}\" -> {1}")
    @CsvSource({"B, BRONZE", "s, SILVER", "G, GOLD", "p, PLATINUM"})
    void fromCodeIsCaseInsensitive(final String code, final Tier expected) {
        assertThat(Tier.fromCode(code)).isEqualTo(expected);
        assertThat(expected.code()).isEqualToIgnoringCase(code);
    }

    @Test
    void fromCode_unknown_throws() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> Tier.fromCode("X"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("Unknown tier code: X");
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @EnumSource(Tier.class)
    void nextNeverDowngrades(final Tier tier) {
        assertThat(tier.next().compareTo(tier)).isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0);
    }

    @Test
    void platinumIsTheTopTier() {
        assertThat(Tier.PLATINUM.next()).isSameAs(Tier.PLATINUM);
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @CsvSource({
            "BRONZE,   999,  9",
            "SILVER,   1000, 12",
            "GOLD,     1000, 15",
            "PLATINUM, 1050, 21"
    })
    void pointsForRoundsDown(final Tier tier, final long spendCents, final int expected) {
        assertThat(tier.pointsFor(spendCents)).isEqualTo(expected);
    }

    @Test
    void multipliersAreStrictlyAscending() {
        double[] m = Arrays.stream(Tier.values()).mapToDouble(Tier::multiplier).toArray();
        for (int i = 1; i < m.length; i++) {
            assertThat(m[i]).isGreaterThan(m[i - 1]);
        }
    }
}
